content.what_it_is: MATLAB Step-2 script of the FUNWAVE IG_waves spectral_data example (header L1-L14, Fengyan Shi 04/06/2021): generates bound infragravity components from the Step-1 wind-wave spectrum and writes the combined FUNWAVE input 'spectrum_random_phase.txt' @L102. Parameters: g=9.81 @L20; LowFreqRange=0.03 @L21 ('range from left and right of peak frequency'); band cuts fre_lowcut=0.0667 @L22 ('15s') and fre_highcut=0.3 @L23 ('3 s'). Loads SPC_dep_pf/SPC_frq/SPC_angle/SPC_HMO (L26-L37) and trims the frequency/Hmo arrays to [n1:n2] nearest the cut frequencies via min(abs(...)) (L31-L33, L37). Amplitudes Amp_each=sqrt(2)/4*spc' @L44; seeded random phases (rng(1) @L49, Phi_each @L50). Pair loop (L57-L91) identical to the 2_wave_components version but with a selection window: only pairs with f(1)>f1 & f(2)<f2 @L65 (f1=peakf-LowFreqRange @L40, f2=peakf+LowFreqRange @L41) generate IG components — wavenumbers from wvnum_omvec @L69, interaction coefficient C @L73, transfer Dnm (L75-L77), bound amplitude anm=Dnm*a(1)*a(2) @L79, difference frequency/wavenumber/phase records (L81-L86). Output file (L102-L120): NumFreq=length(fre)+length(freq_low) @L103, NumDir=1 @L104, PeakPeriod=1/peakf @L105, Freq=[freq_low; fre] @L106, Dire=0.0 @L107, Amp1=[anm_low; Amp_each] @L108, Phase1=[phase_low; Phi_each] @L110; fprintf headers L113-L116 then dlmwrite-appended Amp1 and Phase1 (L117-L118). Plots (L127-L189): reconstructed time series over 0:0.1:1000, spectrum with IG-used components marked (figure 1, plots/windwave_spec_random.jpg @L152), Fnm/anm vs integrated (figure 2, plots/IG_components_random.jpg @L171), wind wave vs IG x10 (figure 3, plots/windwave_and_IG_random.jpg @L182), combined series (figure 4, plots/wave_plus_IG_random.jpg @L189).

verbatim_spans.text: LowFreqRange=0.03; %range from left and right of peak frequency

unresolved: Pair-selection window @L65 requires f(1)>f1 AND f(2)<f2 with f1/f2 = peakf +/- 0.03 Hz — both members of the pair must lie inside the +/-LowFreqRange band around the peak; the comment @L62 says 'sort out using low frequency range' but the test constrains the parent short-wave frequencies, not the difference frequency fnm
If no pair satisfies the window, anm/Fnm/PHI_nm are never created and L95-L98 would error — no guard

IGW_each @L130 repeats the dimensional oddity of adding freq_low inside the cosine argument (diagnostic plots only); element-wise vector-times-row-time products (L128, L130, L133) rely on implicit expansion as in the 2_wave_components script

Header comment block (L1-L13) is identical to IG_wave_generation.m including 'output file: spectrum_random_phase.txt' — here the name matches the actual output, confirming the 2_wave_components copy diverged
lambda @L70, Knm @L82, omega_nm @L72, Eng1 @L109, E @L140, angle @L35 are computed/loaded but unused in the written output; variable 'angle' shadows the MATLAB builtin
